intro: Are you a small business owner or entrepreneur looking for financial assistance to grow your business? 🤔 The PM Mudra Loan Yojana is a government-backed loan scheme that provides financial support to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities. 🌟 In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026. 📈

sections.heading: 🏦 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan Yojana
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan Yojana was launched by the Government of India in 2015 to promote entrepreneurship and job creation in the country. 🌟 The scheme provides loans up to ₹10 lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities. 📊 The loan can be used for various purposes such as starting a new business, expanding an existing business, or purchasing equipment and machinery. 🛠️

sections.heading: 📊 Types of PM Mudra Loans
sections.content: There are three types of PM Mudra Loans: 📝 Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun. 🌈 The Shishu loan is for businesses that require a loan of up to ₹50,000. 📊 The Kishor loan is for businesses that require a loan of up to ₹5 lakhs. 📈 The Tarun loan is for businesses that require a loan of up to ₹10 lakhs. 🚀

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria: 📝 You must be an Indian citizen. 🇮🇳 You must be above 18 years of age. 👴 You must have a business plan or proposal. 📊 You must have a good credit score. 📈

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to submit the following documents: 📁 Identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, etc.) 📝 Address proof (passport, driving license, etc.) 📊 Business plan or proposal 📊 Income tax returns 📊 Bank statement 📊

sections.heading: 📈 How to Apply for PM Mudra Loan Online 2026
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online, follow these steps: 📊 Visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal. 🌐 Fill out the online application form. 📝 Upload the required documents. 📁 Submit the application form. 📈 Wait for the lender to process your application. 🕰️

sections.heading: 📊 PM Mudra Loan Interest Rates and Repayment Terms
sections.content: The interest rate for PM Mudra Loans varies from lender to lender. 📊 However, the interest rate is generally lower than other types of loans. 📈 The repayment term for PM Mudra Loans is up to 5 years. 📆 You can repay the loan in monthly installments. 📊

faqs.q: What is the maximum loan amount that can be borrowed under the PM Mudra Loan Yojana? 🤔
faqs.a: The maximum loan amount that can be borrowed under the PM Mudra Loan Yojana is ₹10 lakhs. 📊

faqs.q: What are the types of businesses that are eligible for a PM Mudra Loan? 🤔
faqs.a: Non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities are eligible for a PM Mudra Loan. 🌟

faqs.q: How long does it take to process a PM Mudra Loan application? 🤔
faqs.a: The processing time for a PM Mudra Loan application varies from lender to lender. 🕰️ However, it typically takes a few days to a week to process the application. 📆
